text: Add a 'root-cause' entry to defaults.toml whose source is the BRIEF.md addendum '2026-10-13: Root causes' (already committed; do not edit BRIEF.md). Statement: when a request reports a failure, find where the fault originates and fix it there, not the symptom or the one instance that surfaced; when the root cause lies outside the request's scope, name it and propose the fix instead of silently working around it; a fix's description names the root cause and why the change addresses it, so the verifier can check it. Say how it relates to 'small': the root-cause fix is the one focused change, and an out-of-scope cause is reported, not fixed.
